g.text: : every response position in the batch (the ✓ s)
✗ the end token left out of the loss → it never learns to stop: it writes until max tokens
✗ another template at inference than in training → a prefix it has never seen (W2 p24)
✗ a control token the base never trained → a noise row, and LoRA does not touch embeddings (p25)
